title: Chessers benchmark workload manifest (v1)
description: The workload suite `chessers-bench` runs, checked in at ChessersEngine.Bench/workloads.v1.json and read by both the C# harness and a future Rust port so the two measure identical work. Iteration counts are declared here, never calibrated at runtime. Unlike the oracle/codec/perf artifacts this is a hand-authored source file, not an emitted one, so it carries no `$schema` marker of its own; check-workloads.ts validates it against this schema.

id.description: Unique `<kind>.<variant>` identifier; the kind dispatches to a WorkloadRegistry implementation.

layer.description: Which layer the workload measures, so a disappointing speedup can be localised.

fixture.description: A TestScenarios method name to seed the position from, or null for the standard opening.

level.description: AI search level; present only where it applies (search and e2e workloads).

countersComparable.description: Absent means true. Set false when the workload's counters depend on the engine's seeded RNG stream, so the comparator reports differences without failing the run.
